title: UW Portfolio Profile
description: A `.uwportfolio.json` sidecar (RFC 0015, Protocol §XV): typed entities and provenance-backed relationship edges spanning UW Markdown deals. The portable carrier for the ENTITY layer of the RFC 0018 edge registry. Out-of-band by design: a sidecar is not part of any `.uwx.md` file, claims no `_meta` ownership, and changes no record's canonical bytes. This schema enforces structure only; the registry-aware rules a validator adds (`validatePortfolioProfile`): unique ids across entities and edges (PORT-006), edge endpoints resolving locally (PORT-008), non-empty provenance per edge (PORT-009), a KNOWN edge type used on the member layer refused (PORT-010), and builtin from/to entity-kind constraints (PORT-011). Unknown entity fields, entity types, and edge types are PRESERVED and reportable, never refused — which is why `additionalProperties` stays open throughout. Provenance `source` is a document/source identifier, NOT the RFC 0031 `_meta.source` actor grammar.

portfolio_version.description: The sidecar's own semver line, independent of the UW format and protocol versions.

portfolio_id.description: Recommended stable identifier for the portfolio this sidecar describes.

id.description: Opaque, case-sensitive, unique within the profile. Consumers MUST NOT derive identity from an id's spelling — a `property:` prefix is producer convention, not grammar.

type.description: One of the initial registered types (property, deal, borrower, loan, document) or an extension type, which consumers MUST preserve and MAY report as uninterpreted.

deal_id.description: For property/deal entities: MUST exactly equal the referenced deal's canonical frontmatter `deal_id` when the deal is available — the sidecar's one anchor into the records it describes.

edge.description: Exactly the RFC 0018 `UWEntityEdge` shape plus a profile-unique `id`. Edge types resolve against the canonical protocol registry (`BUILTIN_EDGE_TYPES`); this schema deliberately does not enumerate them — the registry is the single home (RFC 0018 §5).

source.description: Stable document/source identifier — which artifact says so. NOT the `_meta.source` actor grammar (RFC 0031); the two vocabularies stay apart by construction.

locator.description: Where in the source (page, section, cell). Free text in 1.0, the lease-abstract posture.

retrieved_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of retrieval, when meaningful.
